pli-tv-bi-vb-pc79:1.2: tena kho pana samayena thullanandā bhikkhunī purisasaṃsaṭṭhaṃ kumārakasaṃsaṭṭhaṃ caṇḍiṃ sokavassaṃ sikkhamānaṃ vuṭṭhāpeti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc79:1.3: yā tā bhikkhuniyo appicchā …pe… tā ujjhāyanti khīyanti vipācenti:
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc79:1.4: “kathaṃ hi nāma ayyā thullanandā purisasaṃsaṭṭhaṃ kumārakasaṃsaṭṭhaṃ caṇḍiṃ sokāvassaṃ sikkhamānaṃ vuṭṭhāpessatī”ti …pe…
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc79:1.5: saccaṃ kira bhikkhave thullanandā bhikkhunī purisasaṃsaṭṭhaṃ kumārakasaṃsaṭṭhaṃ caṇḍiṃ sokāvassaṃ sikkhamānaṃ vuṭṭhāpesīti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc79:1.8: kathaṃ hi nāma bhikkhave thullanandā bhikkhunī purisasaṃsaṭṭhaṃ kumārakasaṃsaṭṭhaṃ caṇḍiṃ sokavassaṃ sikkhamānaṃ vuṭṭhāpessati.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc79:1.10: evañca pana bhikkhave bhikkhuniyo imaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ uddisantu:
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc79:1.11.1: “yā pana bhikkhunī purisasaṃsaṭṭhaṃ kumārakasaṃsaṭṭhaṃ caṇḍiṃ sokavassaṃ sikkhamānaṃ vuṭṭhāpeyya pācittiya”nti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc79:2.1.19: vuṭṭhāpessāmīti gaṇaṃ vā ācariniṃ vā pattaṃ vā cīvaraṃ vā pariyesati sīmaṃ vā sammannati āpatti dukkaṭassa.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc79:2.1.23: gaṇassa ca ācariniyā ca āpatti dukkaṭassa.
